an3.183-352:1.4: → (rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā. katame tayo? savitakkasavicāro samādhi, avitakkavicāramatto samādhi, avitakkaavicāro samādhi. rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.) etthantare pāṭho katthaci dissati, aṭṭhakathāyaṁ passitabbo (cck note)
an3.183-352:4.2: abhinandunti → ( ) etthantare pāṭho syā. kaṁ. ka. potthakesu na dissati (cck note)
an3.183-352:4.3:
niṭṭhitaṁ → tassuddānaṁ : pāṇaṁ adinnamicchā ca musāvādī ca pisuṇā 
pharusā samphappalāpo ca abhijjhāvyāpāde diṭṭhi ca 
kammapathesu peyyālaṁ tikakena niyojaye ti. – machasaṁ (bj: kammapathapeyyāle vīsati kammapathasuttāni daṭṭhabbāni. potthekasu akusalaṁ kusala kammapathavasena ekato yojitāni daseva suttāni peyyālamukhehi dissanti. rāga pyolamukhehi sattatyadhikasuttāni daṭṭhabbāni)
an3.183-352:5.1: Rāgaṁ → imā uddānagāthāyo sī. syā. kaṁ. pī. potthakesu na dissanti (cck note)
